text:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout v2026.3.2 to prod-west1 · group=dedicated-shard-03 · change_window=0300-0405UTC
carol-platform: kicking this off now. canary to 5% traffic first 10m. notifying support for status page blurb.
raj-oncall: watching latency and 5xxs. I'll post updates every 2m.
maya-support: thanks — I'll stage a short status page update draft and customer DM template in #support.
deploy-bot: canary step1 complete (5%): all health checks passed, p99 latency +12% vs baseline, 5xx rate 0.18% (baseline 0.02%).
eli-prodops: seeing a small error spike on model-serving pods (OOMs on transformer-2 replicas). digging into pod logs now.
raj-oncall: rolling health: CPU trending up on rack 7, queue depth +30%. pausing rollout. do not proceed to 25%.
lena-pm: hold — we need to notify customers if we rollback. what is eta to fix?
eli-prodops: quick mitigation: drop batch size on affected variant, restart transformer-2 replicas. attempt in 3m.
carol-platform: agree with rollback if we can't stabilize in 10m. priority = availability.
deploy-bot: paused deployment as requested by carol-platform. current canary serving 5%. new step scheduled: observe 10m.
raj-oncall: after restart, p99 back to +5% and 5xx 0.04% — better but still above baseline. queue depth improving.
maya-support: drafting statuspage update: 
```
Incident: Degraded responses for a subset of customers during canary of v2026.3.2
Impact: Elevated error rates and increased latency for requests routed to prod-west1 canary group (5% traffic).
Action: Deployment paused and mitigations applied. Engineers are investigating. No customer-visible rollbacks at this time.
Updated: 03:12 UTC
```
eli-prodops: recommend rolling back canary to v2026.3.1 for prod-west1 while we root-cause. rollback will reduce risk to customer traffic.
lena-pm: approved rollback. please include note about pinned version for affected capacity pools until fix.
carol-platform: timeline: rollback start 03:20 UTC, expected complete 03:24 UTC. status page should reflect rollback and ETA for follow-up.
maya-support: customer DM template draft: 
```
Hi — during a scheduled canary at 03:00 UTC we observed elevated errors and latency for a small set of customers. We paused the rollout and are rolling back the canary to the previous version (v2026.3.1) for the affected region. No action required on your side. We'll follow up with a root-cause summary and timeline for a safe re-release.
```
ops-bot: rollback initiated by carol-platform at 1764508200.
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 1764508225. prod-west1 now serving v2026.3.1 for all traffic. health checks nominal.
raj-oncall: post-rollback telemetry looks clean: p99 and 5xx back to baseline. monitoring will remain on high-sensitivity for 30m.
maya-support: posted statuspage update and queued DM to customers in affected pool. copied the comms into the incident tracker.
lena-pm: we'll pin prod-west1 dedicated-shard-03 to v2026.3.1 until postmortem. please add a follow-up checklist: reproducer, memory profile, batch-size regression test.
eli-prodops: noted. will capture heap dumps and batch-size perf run.
carol-platform: thanks everyone. small, clear messages worked well. capture lessons in a short postmortem and update the release playbook with a step to pre-warm transformer replicas for this model family. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: thread closed for ops tracking.
